title: BPW-2026-0575
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0575
CD 11
AFE – SOUTH COAST AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT DISTRICT
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $295,544 for encumbrance of funds to pay permit and license fees required by the South Coast Air Quality Management District for the period of July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.
(AE27760548M, Fund 760 - Sewer Operations & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
